subtitle: Convert your WireGuard configurations to different formats
converted_placeholder: The converted configuration will appear here...
input_placeholder: Or paste your .conf file content here...
select_files_alert: Please select one or more .conf files.
wizard_input_hint: Drop .conf files or paste content. Detected configs move you forward.
wizard_format_hint: Choose one output format for all configs.
wizard_settings_hint: Tune junk packets and overrides. Defaults work for most users.
wizard_result_hint: Review each config, then copy or download.
validation_fix_to_continue: Fix the errors above to continue
validation_ok: All good — {n} configs ready to convert
val_missing-privatekey_hint: Add a PrivateKey line under [Interface] in “{label}”.
val_malformed-privatekey_hint: It must be a 44-character base64 key ending with “=”. Check “{label}”.
val_missing-publickey_hint: Add a PublicKey line under [Peer] in “{label}”.
val_malformed-publickey_hint: It must be a 44-character base64 key ending with “=”. Check “{label}”.
val_missing-endpoint_hint: Add an Endpoint = host:port line under [Peer] in “{label}”.
val_malformed-endpoint_hint: “{detail}” is not valid host:port. Fix it in “{label}”.
val_missing-allowedips_hint: Usually AllowedIPs = 0.0.0.0/0 — conversion continues without it.
val_missing-address_hint: Add an Address line under [Interface] in “{label}”.
val_malformed-preshared_hint: It must be a 44-character base64 key. Check “{label}”.
empty_hint: Drop .conf files above or paste config text to begin.
help_custom_body: You set the junk values yourself. jc = how many extra packets to add. jmin and jmax = the smallest and biggest size. If that sounds complex, stay with Light or tap Generate Random.
help_amnezia15_body: Extra settings (I1–I5) only for very new Amnezia clients. Most people should leave this off — Light junk alone is enough.
help_advanced_body: Low-level timing options for experts. Wrong numbers can break your connection, so leave this off unless you know exactly what each value does.
help_junk_body: jc = how many junk packets are added to confuse filters. jmin and jmax = the smallest and biggest size of those packets. Bigger numbers mean more cover traffic but slower internet. When in doubt, tap Generate Random.
qr_note: QR codes work best for AmneziaWG and WG Tunnel mobile clients.
gen_offline: You are offline. Paste a config manually.
gen_failed: Auto generate failed. Paste a config manually.
gen_one_per_run: One auto config per run — press Clear to generate again.
fresh_note: Each click registers a brand-new account — never shared.
gen_unreachable: Registration service is unreachable from your network. Check your connection and try again.
gen_rejected: The service refused the request. Try again later.
gen_no_relay: Auto generation is not set up yet — paste a config manually for now.
install_no_match: No official client for this format on this OS. The options below still work with standard configs.
